recap.title: Late turnaround sees Harlow Cross and Marsh Dock United finish 2-2
recap.summary: A 2-2 finish felt like two different games: Marsh Dock United seized control through the middle periods but Harlow Cross clawed back for a stoppage-time reward. At 41' Hartsell’s second yellow left Marsh Dock United down to 10, swinging control as Harlow Cross’s win probability jumped from 36% to 49%. At 45+2' Rookwood struck from a free kick before halftime, flipping Marsh Dock United from 14% to 52% and changing the half-time mood. Then, at 90+1' Whitlock’s late equaliser — assisted by Tolliver — dragged the game from the brink and pushed the draw chance up to 89%. Bellweather was the standout with a match-high 9.2 rating: they forced a big chance at 15' and set up Okonkwo-Reid’s 66' goal, a constant spark for the home side. The box score backs the comeback — Harlow Cross finished with 63% possession, 16 shots and 2.43 xG while Marsh Dock United had 37% possession, 9 shots and 0.73 xG; the top ratings were Bellweather 9.2, Rookwood 8.5 and Okonkwo-Reid 8.4.
